title: Sunny Finds a Glowworm | Bedtime Story
description: Join Sunny the Quokka on a calm, magical night walk through the Australian bush in this gentle bedtime story from Little Sunny. Perfect for toddlers and little ones winding down for sleep.
narration:
As the sun slowly set behind the gum trees, little Sunny the quokka stretched her tiny paws and yawned a big, sleepy yawn.

The bush was turning soft and quiet. Crickets began their gentle song. Somewhere nearby, a frog sang a low, sleepy note.

Sunny padded softly along the mossy path, her big brown eyes wide and wondering.

And then... she saw it.

A tiny, glowing green light, no bigger than a raindrop, nestled beneath a curved piece of bark.

Sunny leaned in, very slowly, very gently.

It was a glowworm. Its little tail glowed like the tiniest lamp in all the bush.

"Hello," whispered Sunny, so quietly that even the leaves barely heard.

The glowworm glowed a little brighter, as if it was saying hello back.

Sunny sat down on the soft, cool earth beside it. She didn't need to touch it or pick it up. It was enough just to be near something so quietly beautiful.

One by one, more tiny lights appeared in the mossy log nearby. A whole little family of glowworms, each one softly glowing.

The stars above began to appear too, blinking awake one by one, as if the sky was learning from the glowworms below.

Sunny looked up at the stars, then down at the glowworms, and she smiled her gentle smile.

Sometimes the most magical things are the quietest ones, she thought.

The breeze moved softly through the ferns. A possum crept by on a high branch. The world was calm and still and full of tiny glowing lights.

Sunny curled up on the warm earth, her chin resting on her paws, and watched the glowworms shimmer until her eyes grew heavy.

The bush held her gently as she drifted off to sleep, surrounded by the soft green glow of her new little friends.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, glowworms. Goodnight, little one.
